title: Mortgage Pre-Approval Conversion to a Loan Application
content:
A Mortgage Pre-Approval converts when the borrower applies for a loan file naming it; only an issued pre-approval converts.

## Intake rule

A pre-approval converts when the borrower applies for a loan file naming it; only an issued pre-approval converts. Where the level honors the approval at application when no material change occurred, the underwriting decision is honored on the loan file unless a material change occurred; where the level reuses the credit report at conversion, the pre-approval's credit report is reused while it is valid. An expired pre-approval must be renewed before it can convert; a borrower may also apply without one.

Conversion is recorded by Larkspur Home Lending's system when the borrower applies: the pre-approval's status becomes converted and its closed date is the date it reached converted.

## Status of the pre-approval at application

| Status when the borrower applies for a loan file naming it | Conversion |
|---|---|
| issued | converts |
| expired | does not convert; an expired pre-approval must be renewed before it can convert |
| requested, declined, withdrawn or converted | does not convert; only an issued pre-approval converts |

## What carries into the loan file

| Level setting | When it applies | Effect on the loan file |
|---|---|---|
| The level honors the approval at application when no material change occurred | no material change occurred | the underwriting decision is honored on the loan file |
| The level honors the approval at application when no material change occurred | a material change occurred | the underwriting decision is not honored |
| The level reuses the credit report at conversion | the pre-approval's credit report is valid | the pre-approval's credit report is reused |

## Intake notes

- A borrower may also apply for a loan file without a pre-approval.
- Hypothetical case: a borrower whose pre-approval expired last week applies for a loan file naming it. The pre-approval does not convert in its expired status; an expired pre-approval must be renewed before it can convert.
- Hypothetical case: a borrower holding an issued pre-approval at a level that honors the approval at application applies for a loan file naming it, and no material change occurred. The pre-approval converts and the underwriting decision is honored on the loan file.
